profile.headline: CPWA, React Developer and Accessibility Champion
profile.summary:
I'm a perpetual learner with a strong compulsion to get things "right", not just "done." My Superpower is that I always find something in every role that I want to dive into further, and that has defined my career.

In my current role, my focus on Accessibility has evolved into a passion and career path, leading me to obtain both IAAP WAS and CPACC certification for my full CPWA. My philosophy is simple -- design and code an application's front-end to be accessible to ALL users and you will automatically produce a quality application. Then strive for usability beyond WCAG standards to provide a superior inclusive experience because ALL users matter. Working in the Accessibility field satisfies both the pragmatist and idealist in me, and I've become a much better developer for it.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · React.js · Web Accessibility · IT Accessibility · JavaScript

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description: Utilizing expertise in both object-oriented and functional programming paradigms to build highly scalable web applications using modern tools and frameworks including ReactJs, Redux, Webpack, and CSS pre-processors, and collaborating with UX design and back-end teams to solve technical challenges and produce a quality production web experience for customers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Team Lead
positions.description:
Led a global-team of engineers in a ReactJS/Redux project to translate our front-end, client-facing application from Actionscript/Flex, while simultaneously maintaining and upgrading the original Flex app. My responsibilities encompassed four primary areas:

Development – writing code for build/release, making design/architecture decisions, leading a contracted 3-member global team

Project Management – translating user stories into technical requirements and creating Jira tickets, writing and maintaining technical documentation, interviewing contractor candidates and making hiring decisions.

Quality Control – performing code reviews and executing merge requests; mentoring junior developers

DevOps – configuring and maintaining the Node and Webpack build environments

positions.title: Software Developer Senior
positions.description: Development and maintenance of in-house custom software.  My experience encompasses both desktop and web applications using a variety of technologies, including Ruby on Rails, C#, HTML, Oracle, PL/SQL.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Software developer with special focus on report generation and QC automation for Data Collection department of accredited market research company.  Technologies included SQL, Oracle, VBA, Visual Basic, C#.

company.name: Simmons Market Research, an Experian Company

positions.title: Senior Data Analyst Consultant
positions.description: Provided quality assurance on all aspects of data collection for multi-modal, accredited national market research study, including output reconciliation, identification of flawed programming algorithms, revision and documentation of programming instructions, design and implementation of testing methodology, and updates to all materials necessary for project execution.  Also served as chief liaison with vendors on programming issues.

company.name: Experian Market Research, an Experian Company

positions.title: Sample Specialist
positions.description:
Responsible for quota-tracking, sample ordering, documentation of methodologies, script-testing, and production of status reports for national market research study

Initiated and implemented report automation for the department.

Designed relational databases with attention to normalization of data, referential integrity, and query optimization.

Delivered an application to track financial institution mergers and acquisitions, resulting in 50% reduction in hours for part-time data entry specialists.

Produced HTML help files for industry-specific software.
